name: A Space In Between
source:
"It pained me to hold this secret feeling for you ... yet the thought of losing you pained me even more."

Lily and Andrea are best friends since childhood. Growing and facing all ups-and-downs in their lives together, they never leave each other's side since the first time they met. Even though physically separated after Andrea and her family moved away to another town, the two of them still as close as ever. Years after years, suddenly a crack appeared in their relationship as they drifted apart, and then Lily realized she had a different feeling for her best friend—a one-sided love that will never be reciprocated.

A bittersweet short story about fear, courage, and overcoming it as a part of growing up.

[From [url=https://eikitaraaaa.itch.io/a-space-in-between]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“对你怀有这种秘密的感觉让我很痛苦……但一想到失去你，我就更痛苦了。”

莉莉和安德里亚从小就是最好的朋友。一起成长，一起面对人生的风风雨雨，从第一次见面开始，他们就没有离开过彼此的身边。尽管安德里亚和她的家人搬到另一个城镇后身体上分开了，但他们两人仍然像以前一样亲密。年复一年，随着两人渐行渐远，他们的关系突然出现裂痕，莉莉意识到她对她最好的朋友有了不同的感觉——一种单方面的、永远不会得到回报的爱。

这是一个苦乐参半的短篇故事，讲述了成长过程中的恐惧、勇气以及克服恐惧的故事。

[来自[url=https://eikitaraaaa.itch.io/a-space-in-between]Itch.io[/url]]
